intro: Assessing authorship, date, method and evidence when comparing two publications about library opening hours.

piezas.titulo: Two publications about a local change

frases.estudio: Komunikat biblioteki z 12 kwietnia informuje o teście późniejszych godzin w trzy soboty.
frases.alumno: A library notice from 12 April reports a trial of extended hours over three Saturdays.

frases.estudio: Dołączono wyniki ankiety przeprowadzonej wśród 400 czytelników oraz opis pytań.
frases.alumno: Survey results from 400 readers and a description of the questions were attached.

frases.estudio: W drugim wpisie napisano, że „wszyscy użytkownicy” sprzeciwiają się zmianie, ale nie podano autora, daty ani źródła tych informacji.
frases.alumno: A second post claims that «all users» oppose the change, but it does not give the author, date or source of that information.

texto: Reliability depends on who publishes, when, with what method and what evidence is offered. An institutional text may have direct access to the data, but its claims must also be checkable.
A publication without an author, date or link to the survey allows fewer checks. Do not conclude that it is false just from its tone: first identify what can be checked.

pregunta.texto: Which feature makes it easier to check the first publication?

opciones.texto: It includes the date, method and size of the survey.
opciones.explicacion: These details allow you to assess how the answers were collected.
An absolute claim does not provide evidence on its own.

opciones.texto: It has no author or date.
opciones.explicacion: The first text does give a date.

pregunta.texto: Which conclusion is most cautious about the second text?

opciones.texto: Its data are hard to check because the author, date and source are missing.
opciones.explicacion: It describes a verifiable limitation without declaring the text false.

opciones.texto: It is false because it disagrees with the library.
opciones.explicacion: Disagreement does not show that a claim is false.

opciones.texto: It is reliable because it speaks on behalf of everyone.
opciones.explicacion: No evidence is offered for that generalisation.

frase.texto: Nie podano autora ani źródła danych.

opciones.texto: The author and the source of the data were not given.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence lists two missing details.

opciones.texto: The author confirmed the source of the data.
opciones.explicacion: The negative form indicates that they were not provided.

opciones.texto: The source published all the authors.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence does not say that.

pregunta.texto: Write in Polish two criteria for evaluating a publication.

textos: Sprawdzam datę publikacji i autora. Porównuję twierdzenia ze źródłem danych.

piezas.explicacion: Model: «Sprawdzam datę publikacji i autora. Porównuję twierdzenia ze źródłem danych». It includes two observable checks, not an absolute judgement.
